text: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. When the Ziphites had gone to Saul and said, “Is not David hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.
listen to the words of my mouth.
ruthless men seek my life— men without regard for God. Selah
the Lord is the one who sustains me.
I will praise your name, O Lord, for it is good.
and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
